plans.objective: P0.1 Foundation. Prepare the approved monorepo/environment, PostgreSQL migration base, observable health and quality gates. No domain behavior in this phase.

tasks.name: Task 1: Scaffold npm workspaces and the FastAPI package with documented Windows setup
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace apps/web and importable rolekai API exist; documented commands work in a clean environment.
.env.example contains placeholders only; no keys, credentials or product functionality are introduced.
tasks.done: Reproducible shell packages and verified Windows run instructions; package versions and interpreter decision recorded.

tasks.name: Task 2: Add PostgreSQL migration scaffolding, health checks and OTel
acceptanceCriteria: Liveness/readiness semantics pass both dependency states.
Migration roundtrip is clean on disposable Postgres; OTel tests find no secret/body values.
tasks.done: Health, migration and telemetry foundations pass against the disposable environment.

tasks.name: Task 3: Wire local and CI quality gates with setup smoke checks
acceptanceCriteria: Every documented local gate has the same CI counterpart.
A deliberately broken type/test is rejected before restoring it; no deployment/automatic Git action exists.
tasks.done: All foundation gates green, Windows smoke check recorded, required setup documented.

plans.objective: P0.2 Core Domain. Persist Candidate/Search Profile evidence, Job/SourceObservation/provenance, Evaluation, Application and Activity with independent contracts. Depends on foundation and disposable PostgreSQL.</objective>

tasks.name: Task 1: Define typed domains, enums and owner-scoped persistence
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover every independent domain and unknown field behavior.
Profile/evidence is user-written; no scoring/LLM/connector side effects enter model constructors.
tasks.done: Domain types and migration match approved model; ownership and immutability constraints proven.

tasks.name: Task 2: Implement profile, job decisions and explicitly authorized Application services
acceptanceCriteria: All protected requests and rollback/idempotence fixtures pass against PostgreSQL.
No service imports an application submission client.
tasks.done: Safe profile/decision/manual-tracking services and auditable transaction invariants.

tasks.name: Task 3: Publish and test the OpenAPI/internal connector contracts
acceptanceCriteria: Contract snapshot and generated types agree; changing a DTO breaks the drift check.
Async accepted responses do not claim completed imports/evaluations.
tasks.done: All phase requirements map to tested schema/service behavior; the frontend can consume a stable contract.

plans.objective: P0.3 Job Ingestion. Manual URL, Remotive and known Greenhouse boards produce normalized, deduplicated, traceable jobs. Consume phase 2 contracts; never introduce Lever/Ashby or automatic submission.</objective>

tasks.name: Task 1: Build three deterministic adapters and versioned fixtures
acceptanceCriteria: Three adapters satisfy the same Pydantic contracts and source fixtures.
Unknowns remain null; unauthorized fetching is rejected before any network request.
tasks.done: Safe deterministic connectors and reproducible fixtures with provenance metadata.

tasks.name: Task 2: Normalize, exact-dedupe and persist observations/provenance
acceptanceCriteria: Reimport keeps one Job, preserved observations and attributable normalized fields.
Similar jobs and cross-owner imports never collapse incorrectly; transaction rollback leaks no success event.
tasks.done: Deterministic normalization/dedupe persists evidence without false certainty or domain crossover.

tasks.name: Task 3: Wire asynchronous imports and the PostgreSQL worker
acceptanceCriteria: Idempotent API/worker recovery and source-isolation tests pass.
Failed imports never falsely return completed evaluations/applications.
tasks.done: End-to-end ingestion pipeline and safe operational status/retry paths.

tasks.name: Task 1: Implement deterministic Mexico/remote eligibility and reasons
acceptanceCriteria: All specified geographical cases return distinct evidenced outcomes.
Unknown and contradiction handling is stable across reimport.
tasks.done: Deterministic policy meets E4-02 without LLM guesses.

tasks.name: Task 2: Implement bounded LangGraph extraction/comparison with evidence validation
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid evidence is rejected/abstained; expected grounded results pass labeled fixtures.
No domain-writing or submission capability is available inside provider tools.
tasks.done: Validated bounded graph, provider seam, dataset labels and privacy policy documented.

tasks.name: Task 3: Persist immutable evaluations and expose safe asynchronous results
acceptanceCriteria: Versioning/retry/ownership/failure isolation integration tests pass.
Previous Evaluation and Job/Applications remain unchanged by new evaluator execution.
tasks.done: Safe asynchronous, inspectable evaluation results and reproducible versions.

tasks.name: Task 1: Build typed Discover, job detail and Saved views
acceptanceCriteria: Filters/detail/decisions pass browser tests including malicious HTML and unknown fields.
State dimensions and source evidence are visible without conflating saved with applied.
tasks.done: Accessible typed review/save flow with no hidden application side effects.

tasks.name: Task 2: Add explicit manual Application registration and separate board
acceptanceCriteria: Explicit confirmation and independent Application board tests pass.
No third-party submission request/tool is present or invoked.
tasks.done: Human-controlled manual tracking visibly distinct from saved jobs.

tasks.name: Task 3: Add minimum Activity and editable profile/evidence Settings
acceptanceCriteria: Profile persistence, evidence and minimum audit view work with keyboard-only navigation.
Deferred capabilities remain absent and are described accurately in user documentation.

plans.objective: P0.6 End-to-End Validation. Prove the first auditable vertical slice, quantify source/evaluator behavior and document recovery/limits. Depends on all prior phases; live checks require authorized source access and approved profile/model configuration.</objective>

tasks.name: Task 1: Prove fixture-based full-stack acceptance and resilience
acceptanceCriteria: Full test suite/gates pass with each failure-class behavior observable.
Idempotence/ownership/SSRF/HTML/redaction and saved-Job authorization have explicit assertions.
tasks.done: Repeatable complete P0 fixture evidence, no unverified success claims.

tasks.name: Task 2: Validate authorized real source samples and labeled evaluator dataset
acceptanceCriteria: All three sources have dated real examples and explicit eligible/ineligible/unknown cases.
Live versus simulated results and measured sample sizes are clearly separated; no invented metrics.
tasks.done: Evidence-backed live acceptance/evaluation report or explicit unresolved gate, never a fabricated pass.

tasks.name: Task 3: Document use, limitations, recovery and final P0 review
acceptanceCriteria: Every approved acceptance item links measured evidence or an explicit open issue.
Setup/use/limits/recovery instructions match actual behavior and require no security bypass.
tasks.done: P0 review package ready for human acceptance, no hidden product/deployment automation.

requirements.text: Monorepo, documented Windows setup, reproducible Node/Python dependencies and environment variables.
PostgreSQL, migration upgrade/downgrade smoke checks, liveness/readiness and OTel without sensitive payloads.
CI/local quality gates for TypeScript, Python, tests and generated API contracts.
Configure roles, Mexico residence and modality with mandatory/preferred rules.
Record dated professional evidence with source, separating fact from inference.
Persist technology preferences for transparent evaluation.
Job/detail retains original description, normalized fields, dates and explicit unknowns.
Immutable observations and field provenance distinguish human corrections.
Separate Job/Evaluation/Application/Activity contracts; owner isolation; saved Job + explicit Application action; atomic append-only activity.
Remotive discovery with attribution/link, bounded frequency and classified errors.
Manual URL with recoverable content or pasted-text fallback; URL/date still saved on inaccessible pages.
Known Greenhouse board/URL imports ID/title/location/URL/content without submission endpoints.
Source ID/URL exact dedupe; retry/reimport preserves observations and creates no duplicate job.
PostgreSQL worker claims, idempotency, bounded retries and source isolation; SSRF/HTML defenses; aggregate ImportRun results.
Mexico/remote eligibility eligible/ineligible/unknown/needs_review with source evidence.
Versioned evaluation separates covered/missing/unknown, cites job/profile evidence, optional relative fit score, no hiring probability.
Discover filtered by source/title/date/modality/eligibility.
Save/dismiss records activity and never creates Application.
Confirmed manual Application from saved Job with separate status board.
Saved Jobs, minimal Activity and Settings/profile views expose evidence and safe errors.

Unit/integration/OpenAPI/evaluation/security fixtures pass; live authorized source examples satisfy the PRD §11 and MVP DoD, including exact duplicates and eligibility variants; documentation records source limitations.
